people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?”
translations.bsb: Then David asked Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly?”
translations.kjv: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?
translations.asv: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me if perchance thy father answer thee roughly?
